name: yiqi-guild-backend
description: 易骑公会官方网站后端API服务

scripts.dev: echo 'Starting backend development server...' && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.start: echo 'Starting backend production server...' && python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test:coverage: echo 'Running backend tests with coverage...' && python -m pytest --cov=src --cov-report=html
scripts.lint: echo 'Running backend linting...' && python -m flake8 src/
scripts.lint:fix: echo 'Fixing backend linting issues...' && python -m autopep8 --in-place --recursive src/
scripts.format: echo 'Formatting backend code...' && python -m black src/
scripts.type-check: echo 'Running backend type checking...' && python -m mypy src/
scripts.clean: echo 'Cleaning backend cache...' && python -c "import os; [os.remove(f) for f in [os.path.join(root, name) for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.') for name in files if name.endswith('.pyc')]]" && python -c "import shutil; [shutil.rmtree(d) for d in [os.path.join(root, dir) for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.') for dir in dirs if dir == '__pycache__']]"
